ख: khá, n. 	—1. hole; hollow; 	—2. opening; 	—3. hole in the hub of a wheel; 	—4. void space; the sky. [√khan, cf. 333.]
खग: kha-ga, 	—1. a. moving in the sky, flying; 	—2. as m. bird. [for mg 2, cf. antarikṣaga and kha-gama, ‘bird,’ ura-ga and bhujaṃ-gama, ‘snake,’ and turaṃ-ga, ‘horse.’]
खण्ड: khaṇḍa, a. broken; as m. a break, section,  piece; khaṇḍaka, m. lump-sugar. [hence, prob., through the Persian, Arabic, Italian, and French, the Eng. candy.]
खन्: √khan or khā (khánati, -te; cakhā́na, cakhnús; ákhān [890]; khaniṣyáti; khātá; khánitum; khanitvā́, khātvā́; -khā́ya; khanyáte, khāyáte; khānáyati). dig; caus. cause to be dug. [if for *skan, cf. Lat. can-ālis, ‘ditch, canal.’] + ā, dig, burrow, in ākhu.
खर: khára, a. harsh; as m. ass (so called from his harsh bray), 6719.
खल: khála, m. 	—1. threshing-floor; 	—2. a mean, low-lived fellow. [the tertium comparationis for 1 and 2 is perhaps ‘dirt.’]
खलु: khálu, pel. 	—1. now (continuative); atha khalu, now; 	—2. indeed (emphasizing the preceding word), 553; 	—3. to be sure (concessive ), 983.
खाद्: √khād (khā́dati; cakhā́da; khādiṣyáte; khāditá; khā́ditum; khāditvā́; khādyáte; khādáyati). chew; bite; eat, esp. of animals; feed on, 2416; devour, 2111; khādita, eaten, 233, etc. [if for *skand or sknd, cf. κνίζω, √κνιδ, ‘bite, sting,’ κνίδη, ‘nettle,’ but not Eng. nettle.]
खिद्: √khid (khidáti; khinná; -khídya). depress,  but only fig. + ud, pull out.
खिल: khilá, 	—1. m. piece of waste land between cultivated fields; a bare spot; 	—2. a gap.
खु: khu, a Prakrit form for khalu.
खेचर: khe-cara, a. moving in the sky. [kha, 1250c.]
खेचरत्व: khecaratva, n. power of flying (by magic). [1239.]
खेदवश: kheda-vaśa, a. having depression as one's controlling influence, under the dominion of sorrow.
ख्या: √khyā (khyā́ti; cakhyaú; ákhyat [847]; khyāsyáti; khyātá; khyā́tum; -khyā́ya; khyāyáte; khyāpáyati, -te [1042d]). simple verb only in pass. and caus. --pass. be well known; be talked of; --caus. make known. [orig. mg, perhaps, ‘shine, appear or look (intrans.), see (trans.)’.] + abhi, look at; behold, 7813. + ā, 	—1. show, tell; narrate, 5519; 	—2. designate, name; --caus.: act. tell; mid. have told to one's self, 1057. + praty-ā, (lit. show back, i. e.) turn away, repulse, reject, 920; refuse. [the Ger. zurück-weisen has just the same mgs.] + vy-ā, show to discriminately, i. e. explain. + sam, tell together, i. e. reckon up. + pari-sam, reckon up completely, 586.
ख्याति: khyāti, f. the being well known; fame; khyātiṃ gam, become famous. [√khyā.]
